name: Decision
description: One company decision: an open question, who owns it, the day it is needed by, and the answer a person gave. What it gates is not stored here; conditions and blocked opportunities point at it.

global.schema:
type DecisionState {
  question: String
  context: String
  owner: EthereumAddress
  decideBy: Date
  status: DecisionStatus!
  answer: String
  answeredBy: EthereumAddress
  answeredAt: DateTime
  reason: String
  references: [Reference!]!
}

enum DecisionStatus {
  OPEN
  ANSWERED
  WITHDRAWN
}

enum ReferenceKind {
  RESEARCH
  NOTE
  SOURCE
  COMPARABLE
  OPPORTUNITY
  LEAD
  DECISION
  OTHER
}

type Reference {
  id: OID!
  kind: ReferenceKind!
  documentId: PHID!
  title: String!
}

modules.name: details
modules.description: The question, who owns it and the day it is needed by

operations.name: SET_QUESTION
operations.description: Set the question. The context changes only when it is given, and null clears it
operations.template: Set the question. The context changes only when it is given, and null clears it

operations.name: SET_DECISION_OWNER
operations.description: Give the decision to a team member. Null leaves it without an owner
operations.template: Give the decision to a team member. Null leaves it without an owner
operations.reducer:
const { owner } = action.input;
if (owner !== undefined) state.owner = owner;

operations.name: SET_DECIDE_BY
operations.description: Set the day the decision is needed by. Null removes it
operations.template: Set the day the decision is needed by. Null removes it
operations.reducer:
const { decideBy } = action.input;
if (decideBy !== undefined) state.decideBy = decideBy;

modules.name: status
modules.description: Answering, reopening and withdrawing the decision

operations.name: ANSWER_DECISION
operations.description: Record the answer a person gave, with who gave it and when. People-only: an agent never answers a decision
operations.template: Record the answer a person gave, with who gave it and when. People-only: an agent never answers a decision

errors.name: DecisionNotOpenError
errors.description: Only an open decision can be answered

operations.name: REOPEN_DECISION
operations.description: Open an answered decision again. The answer leaves the state and stays in the signed history
operations.template: Open an answered decision again. The answer leaves the state and stays in the signed history

errors.name: DecisionNotAnsweredError
errors.description: Only an answered decision can be reopened

operations.name: WITHDRAW_DECISION
operations.description: Withdraw an open decision that is no longer needed. Withdrawal is final
operations.template: Withdraw an open decision that is no longer needed. Withdrawal is final

errors.name: DecisionNotOpenError
errors.description: Only an open decision can be withdrawn

modules.name: references
modules.description: Vault notes, sources and other BD records linked to the decision

operations.name: ADD_REFERENCE
operations.description: Link a vault note, a source or another BD record, with its kind and its title
operations.template: Link a vault note, a source or another BD record, with its kind and its title

errors.name: DuplicateReferenceIdError
errors.description: A reference with this id already exists

errors.name: DuplicateReferenceError
errors.description: The same document is already referenced with the same kind

operations.name: REMOVE_REFERENCE
